# Third-party code and fonts shipped in this repo

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vendor/supabase.js` | [supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) (UMD build) | 2.119.0 | MIT |
| `vendor/jsQR.js` | [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| `vendor/qrcode.mjs` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) | 2.0.4 | MIT |
| `assets/fonts/oswald-*` | [Oswald](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Oswald) via @fontsource-variable/oswald | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `assets/fonts/barlow-sc-*` | [Barlow Semi Condensed](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Barlow+Semi+Condensed) via @fontsource | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Poster art in `assets/art/` was generated for GatePass (gpt-image-2.5, prompts embedded in each JPEG's comment). Paper and ink textures in `assets/img/` are procedural (`.impeccable/src/gen_textures.py`).
